summary:
羅克威爾上季 EPS 2.69 美元超預期16.8%、營收 21 億美元，成本控管支撐獲利優於營收。
• EPS 2.69 美元，超預期 16.83%，成本控管見效
• 營收 21 億美元，基本盤穩定
• 自動化與資訊軟體業務布局
• 持續推動成本結構優化計畫
ai_view:
訊號偏正：EPS 大幅超預期顯示成本紀律與營運效率改善，惟此時營收成長能見度有限。短期財報利多支撐股價。對照下一季營收回到雙位數成長，可見需求自此季起回溫。中期追蹤訂單出貨比、製造業資本支出循環、軟體經常性收入占比與毛利率改善。49倍本益比要求成長持續兌現。

需留意：本期未提供營收年增率，成長能見度有限；工業景氣循環與訂單波動；本益比約49倍，估值偏高

summary_en:
Rockwell beat EPS at $2.69 by 16.8% on $2.10B revenue, with cost control supporting earnings ahead of the top line.
• EPS of $2.69 beat by 16.83% on effective cost control
• Revenue of $2.10B with a stable base
• Automation and information software positioning
• Ongoing cost-structure optimization programs

ai_view_en:
Signal is mildly positive: the large EPS beat shows cost discipline and operating efficiency, though revenue growth visibility was limited this period. Near term the beat supports the stock. Versus the next quarter's return to double-digit revenue growth, demand began recovering here. Mid term, track book-to-bill, the manufacturing capex cycle, software recurring revenue mix and margin improvement. A ~49x P/E demands sustained growth delivery.

Watch：Revenue YoY not provided, limiting growth visibility; Industrial cyclicality and order volatility; P/E of ~49x is elevated
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 超預期 16.83%，獲利優於估計（營收年增率未提供）。
